findings.title: Empty-string failures become observed packets
findings.reproduction: false-complete.mts: pre-abort-empty, prepare-reject-empty, cancel-off-arm-empty, deadline-empty-error all resolve and persist observed. Pre-abort-empty has zero steps and all-zero totals; summary null.
findings.cause: fail stores String(error), but termination/status use string truthiness instead of failure !== null or a discriminated outcome.
findings.required: Track failure independently of message truthiness and require full completion invariants for observed.

findings.title: Malformed or contradictory raw observations are accepted as complete
findings.reproduction: contract-regressions.mts: fence-draw increments first fence-only countersAfter.calls 650 -> 651; poll-wait-failed changes raw final poll value to 37149 (WAIT_FAILED) but preserves condition-satisfied label; malformed-history sets historySizes={}. Each completes all 12 controls and reports observer-cost-issue.
findings.cause: Fence-only counters are checked for nonnegative integers but not equality; poll numeric value is not reconciled with status; temporal fields are only checked for presence.
findings.required: Validate raw enum/status correspondence, no-work counter equality, and temporal value shapes before issuing the next control.

findings.title: Cross-preparation history-index resets pass
findings.reproduction: contract-regressions.mts history-reset starts from parity-corrected CPU fixtures, sets step 3 histIdx before=0/after=1 even though step 2 ended at 1 and the intervening 90 warm-up frames require before=1. frameIdx remains correct. All 12 controls complete observed.
findings.cause: Cross-control comparison preserves frameIdx only; the report validator checks histIdx only within a single control. AtmospherePass toggles histIdx once per frame without resetting it during warm-up.
findings.required: Preserve and validate histIdx parity across warm-up/control boundaries; positive fixtures should obey the same invariant.

findings.title: Gap threshold uses max(range,5), not the requested range + 5 ms
findings.reproduction: Five pairs on=[36,37,38,39,40], off=[30,31,32,33,34], empty fences 8 ms. Every difference is 6 ms; both ranges are 4 ms; both arms stable. Actual decision observer-cost-issue, while the requested additive threshold is 9 ms and should remain inconclusive.
findings.interpretation: This finding reads the user brief both arm ranges + 5 ms literally as an additive tolerance. The worker report describes separate comparisons (max), so the two definitions need reconciliation.
findings.required: Implement the requested additive threshold, including both signs and boundary fixtures, or explicitly resolve the definition discrepancy before acceptance.

findings.title: Cancellation drops a host observation that already returned
findings.reproduction: contract-regressions.mts retain-returned-host-on-abort: the second observe() obtains a valid raw host/load/pin record, aborts with Error, then returns the record. The dispatcher correctly fails, but the retained step.after stays null.
findings.cause: Host assignment happens outside owned(); its post-await abort check throws first. Probe prepare/run deliberately retain inside the awaited operation, but observe does not.
findings.required: Retain host before/after replies inside the owned operation before cancellation/deadline assertions, including late replies.
